heroDescription: Operating 1907-1940, Beaver produced 7.1 million ounces silver from one of the district's deepest shafts at 487.7 meters. Recent surface sampling returned 4.68% cobalt. Sonic drilling confirmed tailings grades up to 314 g/t silver.
historyTitle: 221.7 tonnes silver (7,127,858 ounces) and 140,000 pounds cobalt
historyDescription: Adjacent mines demonstrate district continuity: Temiskaming (12.1M oz), Brady Lake (3.1M oz), Cobalt Load (4.5M oz). Combined cluster production exceeded 26 million ounces.
geologyDescription: Two shafts penetrate entire diabase thickness. Workings discovered silver on both upper and lower contacts. Near-flat fault structures similar to Duchess and Cobalt Load warrant drilling.
tailingsDescription: 2021 program: 354 meters in 127 holes. Silver grades 14-314 g/t from stamp mill tailings. Fine native silver missed by historic processing now recoverable with modern gravity circuits at TTL.
